rows.note: Use this for studying previously learned material, especially before an exam.

example.english: I need to do revision on all my notes because I have an exam this week.
example.traditional: 今個星期要考試，我要溫習晒啲筆記。
example.jyutping: gam1 go3 sing1 kei4 jiu3 haau2 si3 ngo5 jiu3 wan1 zaap6 saai3 di1 bat1 gei3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the process of editing or amending something, and for a general modification rather than a new edition.

example.english: I made several rounds of revision to this document, and it’s finally ready to submit.
example.traditional: 呢份文件我修改咗幾次，終於交得喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 man4 gin6 ngo5 sau1 goi2 zo2 gei2 ci3 zung1 jyu1 gaau1 dak1 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically when the revision is a changed edition or new version of a document, book, or other work.

example.english: The revision of this book contains lots of updated content.
example.traditional: 呢本書出咗修訂版，內容更新咗好多。
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 syu1 ceot1 zo2 sau1 ding6 baan2 noi6 jung4 gang1 san1 zo2 hou2 do1
